requirement.statement: The repository SHALL own source-language and data-processing capabilities only: core expression/SPL flow, SQLite adapter, Kon SPL DSL, composer, web-shared, and the Kon-only private server/IDE. ORM adapter conformance tests SHALL be owned outside this repository.

case.when: manifests and production imports are inspected
case.then: every retained package SHALL remain present and wired without a dependency on retired Domain package identities

case.given: the retained workspace and demo data
case.when: tests, builds, typechecks, Kon server smoke, and Kon Playwright E2E run
case.then: source/data behavior and the Kon product SHALL remain green

requirement.statement: The repository SHALL NOT own or expose the extracted Domain protocol, Domain runtime, Domain server adapter, reference Domain contexts, canonical Domain HTTP routes, or Domain Workbench UI.

case.given: source packages, tests, fixtures, root lifecycle, and current Codument authority
case.then: retired package directories, identities, registrations, routes, UI surfaces, and current owner claims SHALL be absent

case.given: the remaining private Web server and IDE
case.when: their production routes and views are inspected
case.then: only Kon execution and Kon IDE surfaces SHALL remain, with no Domain catalog or execute surface
